blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, Philippines — Rev. Fr. Gerry Gamaliel Sebastian Delos Reyes was appointed by Pope Leo XIV as the Apostolic Vicar of Jolo, the Oblates of Mary Immaculate (OMI) announced in a statement on Saturday. According to the OMI community, the Holy See press office made the appointment public at noon in Rome on Saturday,
